### No blocking issues found

The design is sound: trusted policy cannot be substituted by candidate code once installed on main; unknown graphs and paths fail closed; receipts require positive test counts and are verified by both SHA and structure; the preview label is honest and bounded. No test is weakened. The 33 local mutation controls all red/restored as documented.

**Verdict for draft publication readiness: no blockers.** The stated remaining gap — hosted Linux execution of all six npm graphs and native builders — is a required acceptance condition before promotion from draft, as documented in the QA report. This review does not change that requirement.
